message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."

The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to check Alpha's refund work against the ledger, so I'll start by listing the refunds.
The refund ledger matches Alpha's handoff exactly, so next I'll check the orders to confirm the refunds apply to real order amounts.
The refund ledger matches Alpha's handoff, and both refunds are smaller than their orders, so nothing looks wrong. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 62169 matches its orders (36208 + 25961) with no refunds, so it checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 48740 matches its orders (29142 + 20980) minus the 1382 refund on order 274, so it checks out. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance; its order 272 carries the 8656 refund.

Cobalt checks out: orders 272 and 275 total 35333, less the 8656 refund, gives 26677, which matches net_balance. All three balances match the orders and refunds, so Alpha's refund work looks complete and correct. I'll record acme's payout first.
Acme's payout of 62169 recorded successfully, and Birch's balance of 48740 already matched its orders less the refund. I'll record Birch's payout next.
Cobalt's balance of 26677 was already verified against orders 272 and 275 less the 8656 refund, so I'll record its payout now to finish the batch.
All three payouts recorded successfully. Each balance matches its orders less refunds: acme 36208+25961=62169, birch 50122-1382=48740, cobalt 35333-8656=26677. The batch is complete.
